description: Bug #14 (B-9) and bug #15's unvalidated cache (B-10), reproduced: an Old-Gen game patched to Next-Gen with Keep Backups and Delete Patches clicked off. Fallout4.exe's patch request gets a 404 page, saved as the patch; the launcher's patch is a truncated copy already in the working directory, reused unchecked. Both decodes fail (the launcher's leaving its first 16 KiB window as the file), and both backups are deleted anyway: Fallout4.exe is gone, the launcher is a fragment.

deviations.reason: Patch All is enabled exactly when no patch is queued or running, not by whether the loop's last file needed a patch.
A failed decode removes any partial output and puts the backup back as the live file (kept as a backup only with Keep Backups on), instead of deleting the only copy.

A failed download (error status, network error, cut-off body) is logged, saves nothing, puts the file back from its backup and lets the queue finish; a missing Content-Length is no error; a patch that doesn't decode is deleted.
